# Humanward Labs

> Humanward Labs is a human-centered product and experience design studio in Richmond, Virginia, grounded in behavioral economics and decision-making. Its work has created over $1.3 billion in impact for brands including Circuit City, Microsoft, Allianz, Intersections and Capital One. Its principal created Marketing Research and Competitive Analysis, a GPT ranked #2 in Research & Analysis on the GPT Store with over 1.28 million conversations.

Humanward Labs offers three services: product design, experience design and design strategy. Behavioral economics and decision science shape every product and experience it designs.

## Pages

- [Home (Markdown)](https://humanwardlabs.com/index.md): the full site content in Markdown, including services, approach, impact and FAQ.
- [Home](https://humanwardlabs.com/): the website.

## Services

- Product Design: interface and interaction design, prototypes tested with real people, and design systems that scale.
- Experience Design: journey maps and service blueprints that connect app, web, email and in-person touchpoints into one experience.
- Design Strategy: customer research, opportunity mapping and roadmaps tied to business outcomes.

## Approach

Designed for how people actually decide: behavioral economics and decision science shape every product and experience Humanward Labs designs.

## Principles

Great experiences are useful, usable, desirable, findable, accessible, credible and valuable.
